en.headline: Hong Kong’s first astronaut Lai Ka-ying set to return after completing Shenzhou-23 tasks
en.dek: The China Manned Space Agency said she performed space science work and outreach well, and will return with the Pakistani astronaut after Wednesday’s Shenzhou-24 launch.
body: Hong Kong’s first astronaut, Lai Ka-ying, is expected to return to Earth after completing her tasks on the Shenzhou-23 mission, the China Manned Space Agency said on Tuesday.

A spokesman for the agency said Lai, as payload specialist, completed space science research, technical tests and science popularisation lectures, including work on rice experiments and a live educational session for Hong Kong and Macao students.

The Shenzhou-24 spacecraft is scheduled to launch at 08:18 Beijing time on Wednesday. After the crew handover, Lai is set to return with Zhang Zhiyuan and the Pakistani payload specialist, while commander Zhu Yangzhu remains for a one-year orbital residency trial.
Lai has been on the Tiangong space station since May with her crewmates.

zh.headline: 香港首位航天員黎家盈完成神舟二十三號任務 料將返回
zh.dek: 載人航天工程辦公室稱她出色完成科研及科普工作，將隨周三發射的神舟二十四號乘組輪換後返回。
body: 中國載人航天工程辦公室周二表示，香港首位航天員黎家盈已完成神舟二十三號任務的各項工作，料將返回地球。
發言人指，黎家盈作為載荷專家，以嚴謹態度完成空間科學研究、技術試驗及科普講座，包括水稻相關實驗，並曾為港澳學生進行天宮課堂。
神舟二十四號載人飛船定於周三上午8時18分（北京時間）發射。乘組輪換後，黎家盈將與張志遠及巴基斯坦載荷專家一同返回，而指令長朱楊柱則留站進行為期一年的駐留試驗。
黎家盈自5月起與隊友進入天宮空間站工作。
